title: Goodwill Credit on Late Delivery Claims: Entitlement and Console Action
content:
**Entitlement.** An approved Delivery Claims Late Delivery Claim is owed a Goodwill Credit wherever its make-good amount is not covered by the delivery-charge refund booked on it, booked as one goodwill credit entry on the claim for the whole parcel.

**Principle.** A missed delivery guarantee is made good up to the late-delivery make-good amount: any delivery-charge refund on the claim counts toward that amount, and a Goodwill Credit pays the part of it the refund leaves uncovered.

**Timing of the figure.** The Goodwill Credit on a Late Delivery Claim is fixed only after any delivery-charge refund owed on the claim stands on it as a compensation entry.

Booking the entry does not by itself resolve the claim.

| Approved Late Delivery Claim | Goodwill Credit owed |
|---|---|
| make-good amount not covered by the delivery-charge refund booked on the claim | yes — one goodwill credit entry for the whole parcel |
| make-good amount fully covered by that refund | none |

Once booked, the Goodwill Credit stands on the claim as a compensation entry among the claim's compensation records, dated the day it was booked, with no order line and no units. The claim's status is not changed by the booking.

## Console action: `book_late_delivery_goodwill_699f3402`

**Situation of use and capability.** Books the Goodwill Credit given on a Late Delivery Claim as one compensation entry on that claim. One call records, on an approved claim for a guaranteed parcel that arrived late, the Goodwill Credit the customer receives: a single goodwill-credit compensation entry, dated today, for the whole parcel (no order line, no units), carrying the credit value. The claim's status is not changed. The booked credit value shows among the claim's compensation records.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `book_late_delivery_goodwill_699f3402`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the claim number of the Late Delivery Claim the credit is booked on, as returned by the delivery-claim lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the Goodwill Credit value given on the claim, in USD | a positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places (to the nearest cent, on the final figure); stored exactly as passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `entry_id` (the reference of the new compensation entry), `claim_id` (the claim it was booked on), `compensation_type` (always `goodwill_credit`), `amount_usd` (the credit value booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `booked_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving this receipt means the Goodwill Credit entry now stands on the claim.
